Executive Audit Conclusions: Re-establishing MRP Governance

1. Halt Plant Maintenance Bypasses:

With 571 MRP items currently being requisitioned 100% by plant maintenance, MACC ERP workflow should restrict non-MRP users from creating direct PRs for items carrying an active MRP controller.

2. Enforce Automatic ROP Triggers:

Over 901 items were ordered only after warehouse stock hit zero. Re-calibrating ERP safety stocks and lead times will allow automated replenishment before silent stockouts occur.

3. Consolidate Repetitive Demands:

Items like Flashlights, Oxygen, LPG, and Batteries are ordered 7 to 11 times a year across multiple plants. Transitioning these items to 1-Year Blanket Purchase Agreements will save over 60% of routine purchasing transactions.
